proof_cases.title: Nutrien price versus margin
proof_cases.expected_display: Display higher blended realization alongside lower comparable unit margin.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: Pure DAP quote, fertilizer-only scope, company ranking or global profitability.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Admit source/measurement scope; retain reported period and current rights.

proof_cases.title: NOVONIX customer test
proof_cases.expected_display: Separate customer-test result, internal testing and conditional future sales.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: 86% qualification or probability; current saleable capacity.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Source-local product/customer scope and distinct clocks must survive native admission.

proof_cases.title: NOVONIX later MOU
proof_cases.expected_display: Keep newer nonbinding collaboration distinct from earlier customer-test proposition.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: Issuer-level latest-news flag resolves or refreshes unrelated proposition.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Predicate-specific revision relation; do not infer no other subsequent disclosure exists.

proof_cases.title: Wheaton Antamina cash right
proof_cases.expected_display: Display dated source-attributed payable participation, payments and step-down.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: Mine ownership/control, additional physical supply or complete current contract.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Admit dated statement; current contractual valuation stays blocked until terms complete.

proof_cases.title: Weyerhaeuser cash after investment
proof_cases.expected_display: Explain cash after all stated capex separately from issuer-adjusted FAD.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: Growth spending did not occur or adjusted distribution metric is sustainable FCF.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Retain definitions and scope; formula inputs refer to exact admitted source items.

proof_cases.title: AMS current quote unavailable
proof_cases.expected_display: Show unavailable current quote with version mismatch reason.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: A later parsed date legitimizes an older rendered number.
proof_cases.next_evidence: One version-bound original with consistent period/body/rendering is needed.

proof_cases.title: China comparison unavailable
proof_cases.expected_display: Show bounded China coverage gap, not zero exposure.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: No Chinese opportunity or full global coverage.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Original admissible evidence plus source identity and rights for chosen next cohort.

proof_cases.title: Unresolved company/issuer/security axes
proof_cases.expected_display: Retain useful source-native block; withhold unproven security/portfolio relevance.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: A familiar ticker creates a cross-type identity join.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Actual owner resolution and dated source-to-issuer association.

proof_cases.title: Current evidence receipt extension
proof_cases.expected_display: Current legacy receipt passes schema; unsupported assertion is rejected.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: Schema test proves the new payload persists or real sources were admitted.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Shared schema/store/serializer/read path must be changed and tested by current owners before production use.

proof_cases.title: K1 native blocks versus joined recipe
proof_cases.expected_display: Native-only subjects stay native; unsupported unified recipe stays refused/degraded.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: Side-by-side blocks equal a passed security recipe.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Accepted bridge-object input and actual consumed resolution before unified recipe.

proof_cases.title: Rights and private transport
proof_cases.expected_display: Reject disallowed current rights before private reads; protect success/error paths.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: Mint-time flag or existing Earnings route authorizes a new public Materials payload.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Native source/publication binding and real alternate-path denial proof.

proof_cases.title: Measurement incompatibility
proof_cases.expected_display: Withhold mixed grade, currency, perimeter and denominator calculations.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: Exact arithmetic implies economically comparable quantities.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Native exact scope and reviewed formula; residuals remain explicit.

proof_cases.title: Correction and historical cutoff
proof_cases.expected_display: Append corrected source; recompile affected outputs under the eligible information cutoff.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: Todays knowledge or membership becomes historical replay.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Owner clocks, predecessor refs and supported native vintages.

proof_cases.title: Evidence repetition
proof_cases.expected_display: Expose dependence without claiming independent verification from another URL.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: Automatic dedup, suppression or added confidence under current K1.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Existing lineage/independence owner supports any stronger claim.

proof_cases.title: Scenario and priority separation
proof_cases.expected_display: Show assumed inputs/results separately and preserve F04 identity sorting.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: Scenario replaces absent facts or becomes security ranking.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Future policy/evaluation acceptance before prioritization or predictive use.

proof_cases.title: Real user journey and unchanged legacy
proof_cases.expected_display: Paid user can inspect explanation and lawful company/source links; legacy decisions unchanged.
proof_cases.forbidden_inference: Fixture, CI, API200 or publication alone completes the user mission.
proof_cases.next_evidence: Exact input/code receipts, independent review and desktop/mobile EN/ZH dark/light plus denial proof.

acceptance_requirements.requirement: Sector, canonical theme, source-local subtheme, facet and basket identities remain distinct.
Descriptive Materials membership never changes a structural sector or live basket.
Company, issuer, security and listing links require the correct accepted identity axes.
No ticker-equality or source-symbol fallback resolves an unsupported join.
Existing closed native receipt rejects an unsupported extra assertion; accepted extension is explicitly versioned.
The accepted assertion survives native storage/readback without dropped fields or legacy semantic changes.
Formal financial facts remain with FIF when applicable; press-release data are not fictional XBRL occurrences.
K1 references remain pointer-only and do not embed source/owner bodies.
Native evidence subjects cannot impersonate security subjects in a recipe.
Separate valid blocks never masquerade as one successfully joined company recipe.
Prices/costs/quantities require matching economically material comparison scope.
Reported precision and unresolved perimeter residuals are retained.
Nutrien's chosen comparison retains blended manufactured-product, currency and period scope.
NOVONIX internal testing, customer test and conditional future sales remain separate.
The later nonbinding MOU does not supersede or resolve the customer-test proposition.
Wheaton's contractual interest is not mine ownership or additional physical production.
Weyerhaeuser's adjusted FAD does not erase growth capital paid in the period.
Date, availability, retention, curation and forecast clocks remain lossless and grain-aware.
Corrections append and invalidate only affected derived outputs with explicit predecessor lineage.
A second URL or projection is not independently verified corroboration.
Unknown, zero, false, stale, rights-blocked and unresolved-identity states remain distinguishable.
AMS version mismatch and China quantitative gap do not become current values or zero exposure.
Current source rights are checked independently of mint-time flags.
Approved private source/assertion bodies cannot be recovered from public Git/site/cache/mirrors.
Authentication and paid entitlement precede private-object reads, including malformed routes and errors.
F04 identity ordering and research-display-only authority remain unchanged.
Hypothetical assumptions and results are separated from reported evidence and cannot silently fill missing data.
Historical replay uses supported native vintages and knowledge cutoffs, not today's membership or revisions.
Existing recommendations, ranks, entries, sizes and portfolio outputs are unchanged on frozen inputs.
The real deployed route completes source-to-explanation-to-lawful-company navigation for all selected positive cases.
Desktop/mobile, EN/ZH, dark/light, keyboard and evidence-denial cases remain usable and semantically consistent.
Exact code/input/private-publication receipts, independent review and required live/browser evidence are durable before acceptance.
